implemented: desktop side rails became summoned SOURCE / DETAIL drawers
PAGE gains warm-paper material mode; MAP/SETS remain darker analytical projections
selected token gains compact golden-angle wheel: NEXT / TURN / ECHO / WILD / MORE
wheel and detailed intent dock share the same candidate request function
forms and map-law/aperture sliders move behind explicit advanced disclosures without deletion
reuses APERTURE 0.4 component inside DETAIL for document→paragraph→sentence→word zoom and RSVP
FIELD NOW fetches current active fronts, retained heads and open issue titles as working text
FIELD NOW also builds a session-only candidate corpus from retained functions and manifest route descriptions
fresh sessions attempt FIELD NOW first; tiny poetic demo is fallback, not the default identity
manual source/import/donor load clears FIELD-origin label so source provenance does not lie
interaction_law: LINEAR SOURCE → SELECTED CENTER → SMALL CONTEXTUAL MOVE SET → OPTIONAL RADIAL/ZOOM/FORM DEPTH → EXPLICIT ADOPT/RETURN
non_goals: No claim that golden-angle placement improves cognition; it is a compact layout device.
No requirement that source material be poetry.
No merge of Verse Atlas, Pathweaver, Market+Solver, Grid Path or Foundry into this route.

test.primary: fresh open → FIELD NOW visible without drawers → select a term in PAGE → wheel action → candidate bank only then opens → TRY→ADOPT → optional MAP → RETURN
test.pass: 0.2.1 reaches one meaningful choice with comparable or lower first-contact complexity while retaining the deeper 0.2 mechanisms
test.fail: forms/provider/map-law concepts are required before the first useful manipulation, or the wheel obscures the source
